Case studies

Four projects in detail, showing how I moved from the brief and user problem to design decisions, delivery, testing and handover.

  • Advanced Learning WorldLearning product and solution architectureBilingual K-12 platform on Open edX with a custom student, parent and mentor experience. Launched to production in 3.5 months with delivery partner EPAM.
  • UNECE SITCINLearning, UX and platform rebuildStarting with multilingual learning and a redesign brief, I helped transform a fragile Drupal assessment application into a system that three countries could pilot end to end.
  • OSCE and UNECE eTIRKnowledge access and communicationI developed a Drupal guidance site and an explainer video for customs and transport audiences, with content and administration tools for the secretariat.
  • KPMG and CBRELearning for digital adoptionRole-based courses, realistic system simulations, job aids and communications aligned with major CRM and procurement rollouts.
